notes.title: 1.1 Content Update
notes.content:
[h1]New monsters, more improvements, and multiple bug fixes.[/h1]

Game Improvements[list]
[*]Flying Bats will now periodically attack you from the sky.[/*]
[*]Zombie Horde event every ten waves.[/*]
[*]Enable and Disable Flying Bats and Zombie Horde in the Zombie Options.[/*]
[*]Voice Chat lowers other sounds while active to hear better during live fire.[/*]
[*]Baseball Bat now has wire on the end.[/*]
[*]50 Caliber Sniper Rile has a better scope.[/*]
[*]Bolt Action Sniper Rile has a better scope.[/*]
[*]M16 has a scope.[/*]
[*]A new stat panel showing head shots, bat kills, and total zombie kills.[/*]
[*]Invite friends in and out of game from the Steam Friends overlay.[/*]
[*]Changed the wave started, ending, and game over voice to sound effects instead.[/*]
[/list]
Bug Fixes[list]
[*]Melee weapons work again after restarting the game.[/*]
[*]Magnum alignment fixes after firing a shot.[/*]
[*]Lobby friends should be visible without refreshing.[/*]
[*]Zombies will no longer try to run away.[/*]
[*]No extra zombies will spawn when a round ends.[/*]
[*]Running Zombies have better motion for clients.[/*]
[*]Automatic weapons no longer keep firing when dead.[/*]
[*]Uzi muzzle flash fixes.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: 1.05 Join Games in Progress Update
notes.content:
[h1]Games in progress are now visible in the lobby list and are joinable mid-game![/h1]

All co-op games, including games in progress, are now visible in the lobby at all times. Players can [b]join and rejoin rooms on the fly.[/b] This will make more rooms available and give you something to do while waiting for more players to join your room. Co-op games get harder with more players. Previously when creating a co-op game you would have to wait for others to join before starting the game, and the games already in progress did not show up in the lobby list reducing the number of lobbies available.
[list]
[*]Join or rejoin online games in progress.[/*]
[*]Everyone can start the game.[/*]
[*]Everyone can restart the game.[/*]
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause a host to shutdown on a client disconnect.[/*]
[*]Joining new games resets your points and weapons.[/*]
[*]Lobby refreshes when shown.[/*]
[*]Reduced the cost of SMGs.[/*]
[*]Increased the cost of the 50 Caliber Rifle.[/*]
[/list]
Have fun [b]Killing Zombies![/b]

notes.title: 1.04 Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
[h1]A few fixes from the Halloween update have been improved.[/h1]
[list]
[*]New sound effects for player death, wave starting and ending, game started and finished.[/*]
[*]Fixed an issue that would cause gun lasers to be left behind when switching weapons.[/*]
[*]Game is named correctly again.[/*]
[*]Players see each other reloading again.[/*]
[*]Revolver positioning and light fixed.[/*]
[*]Revolver no longer fires when recoiling.[/*]
[*]Fixed an issue that would cause zombies to slow down in spawn speed after wave 16.[/*]
[*]Players see each other shoot the Grenade Launcher.[/*]
[*]Players see one clip reload instead of two.[/*]
[*]Damage to other players will no longer sometimes cause damage to you.[/*]
[*]Made preparations for a second map.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: 1.03 Halloween Update
notes.content:
[h1]Many improvements to the game.[/h1]
[list]
[*]Invite Steam friends to join your game.[/*]
[*]Greatly reduced the overall network traffic in online co-op.[/*]
[*]New reload sound for the M1 Garand.[/*]
[*]More zombies in first waves.[/*]
[*]Voip should now work with 4 players. Hold down the dial pad to voice chat.[/*]
[*]Zombie options now synced server and clients.[/*]
[*]Set the guns of other players to the correct positions.[/*]
[*]Menu button opens menu panel for leaving games.[/*]
[*]Made the AK-47 smaller.[/*]
[/list]
